messages:
morgan: Heads-up — multiple customers reporting intermittent 503/504s from eu-west dedicated pool 45 starting ~08:12 UTC. Looks like capacity is scaling up/down rapidly and taking requests down with it. Seeing spike in scale events in the past 20m.

sam: Can you paste the autoscale events?

morgan: logs: `scale: pool=dedicated-45 action=scale_up delta=2 desired=6 reason='util=78% topo=default'` then 90s later `scale: pool=dedicated-45 action=scale_down delta=2 desired=4 reason='util=42% topo=default'` repeatedly. Also customer_123 saw `503 Service Unavailable` and `upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out)` in router.

joy: Looks like oscillation. frequency ~ 1.5m cycle. Any recent config changes to cooldown/metric?

kiran: I just checked — we have cooldown=60s, target_utilization=65% on that pool. Metric is CPU utilization (avg over 30s sample).

morgan: Also noticing KV cache cold misses after scale_up -> cpu drops but latency jumps p95 until cache warms and then we scale down. That creates the feedback loop.

ops-bot: Incident alert: dedicated-pool-45 autoscale-flapping threshold exceeded (50 events / 15m).

sam: Repro curl to call kernel: `curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.example/generate` — saw 503s on some requests.

joy: Probable causes: (1) using instant CPU averages = noisy metric, (2) cache-warm latency pattern drives CPU down, (3) cooldown too short -> oscillation. Also possible noisy neighbor consuming single GPU causing eviction.

kiran: I pulled node logs — one worker had OOM and restarted 3x during the window. PID 2435 had memory spike from a long-running batch job for customer_456. Not sure if that is correlated.

support-bot: Customer_123 reported an elevated error rate and submitted request id=ry7f-9k. Forwarded to support.

sam: Proposed mitigations (quick):
- increase cooldown to 180s
- change scale metric to p95 request latency (15s window) OR use smoothed CPU (60s moving avg)
- set min_replicas=5 for pool 45 to reduce evictions
- add per-tenant RB limits to prevent large one-off batch spikes

joy: Agree. Also add a 3-min smoothing window and dampening factor (scale change cap delta<=2 per 5m).

rami: If we change metric to latency, need to ensure the metric is emitted with low-lag; our current path emits p95 with ~10s delay. That's ok for cooldown 3m.

morgan: Quick test: I've queued a synthetic load to stage with same traffic shape; will flip cooldown and smoothing there first.

kiran: ACTION: I'll add temporary autoscale override for pool=dedicated-45: cooldown=180, min_replicas=5, max_scale_delta=2. Will monitor for 30m. Assigned to @kiran.

sam: ACTION: I'll patch the scale controller to support p95 latency policy as an option and add a small smoothing alpha. Will create PR and canary to staging. Assigned @sam.

joy: For noisy neighbor: ACTION: @morgan please pull top consumer list and if tenant > 50% GPU for >10m, throttle as emergency.

morgan: Will do and post results.

deploy-bot: Deploy of autoscale override to dedicated-45 scheduled by kiran (change set cs-789).

kiran: Deployed. Monitoring graphs: CPU stable, p95 latency still has spikes but fewer scale events in the last 10m. No 503s in last 7m.

morgan: Customer-facing update: sent a note to affected accounts explaining temporary scaling policy changes, ETA for rollback after validation.

support-bot: Customer_123 replied: saw improvements but still occasional 502s during long prompts.

sam: Next steps: (1) finish PR for latency-based policy, (2) add smoothing to controller, (3) add tenant-level job caps and better eviction signals, (4) postmortem if this repeats after changes.

morgan: Postmortem draft started — will include timeline, config diffs, and proposed control-plane improvements.

joy: If things look stable after 45m, we can keep override for 24h and then roll into a controlled rollout.

kiran: Last check: autoscale events reduced from 62->6 in 20m after override. Will keep monitoring.

morgan: Thanks team. Marking this thread resolved when we confirm 1h stability.

sam: :thumbsup:

rami: Logging NOTE — save the raw scale event stream to S3 for analysis (kiran can you ensure cs-789 includes event export?).

kiran: Yep added export to s3://redwood-ops/autoscale-events/1768001234/

morgan: Closing for now. If anyone sees regressions ping oncall and reopen.
